topic: Bachche ke operation se pehle kya karein

cap.q: Didi: "Doctor Madam, mere bachche ka operation hai, pehle kya karoon?"
cap.a: Dr Saathi: "Didi, ghabraiye mat, thodi taiyaari, bachcha aaraam se rahega!"
cap.f: Bachche ko sach bataiye, aasaan shabdon mein. Pasandida khilona saath le aaiye.

youtube.description:
Didi ne poocha: "Mere bachche ka operation hai, pehle kya karoon?" 🧸
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Didi, ghabraiye mat, thodi taiyaari se bachcha aaraam se rahega! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Bachche ko sach bataiye — aasaan, shaant shabdon mein, ki operation hona hai
✅ Uska pasandida khilona ya chaadar saath le aaiye
✅ Khaane-peene ki timing wahi rakhiye jo doctor/hospital ne batayi hai
✅ Aap shaant rahengi toh bachcha bhi shaant rahega — koi sawaal ho toh doctor se poochhiye

Darr nahi, taiyaari!
